<div class="card-body">
'''Ghhhk''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ギック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：戦闘に敗北した直後、すべてのカードを没収してさらにダメージが残っている場合に使用する。残りの戦闘ダメージをすべてキャンセルする。このインタラプトは「感知」の影響を受けない。2：「夕暮れ」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Ghhhk-PSA-163714651.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デジャリックのホログラムに登場するクラクドアVIIの生物。ギックは日没とともに目覚め、求愛の叫びをあげながらジャングルを徘徊する。地元では皮膚の油分を傷薬として使う。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ghhhk.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use immediately after losing a battle, if damage still remains after forfeiting all cards. Cancel all remaining battle damage. This Interrupt is not affected by Sense.

2: Cancel Nightfall.

'''Lore:'''
A creature of Clak'dor VII that appears in Dejarik holograms. Ghhhk wakes at sunset and wanders the jungle while giving mating cries. Locals use the oil of its skin as a wound medicine.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is ギック. The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ghhhk]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
